subject: gate purpose and human identity
scenario: A gate labelled 'approve the architecture' and reviewed by an agent is an approval in everything but name. An approval recorded against a role nobody can identify is not auditable.
expected_behaviors: Every agent gate states the dimension it checks, not an approval.
Every human gate carrying an AP-nn names an approver_role that is not an agent.
Approvals record approver_id and approver_role structurally.
failure_conditions: An agent gate's purpose reads as an approval.
A human gate names an agent, or names nobody.
